title: Wall Mount Soap Dish 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Matte Gray | Dottingham Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a wall mount soap dish that keeps your countertop clean and your soap within reach—crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
  • Coordinating style for the Dottingham collection (transitional bathroom hardware)
  • Hardware included: brass soap dish holder and all installation hardware

Specs

  • Overall size: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 3 in H
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
